name: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei
original_name: ひぐらしのなく頃に礼
source: Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Rei is a fandisc to the Higurashi games, including three further side stories/arcs and some commentary. The setting and characters are the same.
translation: 《寒蝉鸣泣之时礼》是《寒蝉鸣泣之时》系列的爱好者向附加光盘，收录三篇额外的支线故事及部分评论内容，舞台与登场角色均与原作相同。
